leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a middleware function that generates a unique correlation ID for incoming HTTP requests
Apply the correlation ID to the request object for use in subsequent middleware and route handlers
Configure the middleware to check for existing correlation IDs in request headers and reuse them when present
Integrate the correlation ID middleware into an Express application using app.use()
Manipulate response headers to include the correlation ID for client-side tracking
Construct a logging mechanism that includes the correlation ID in all log entries for request tracing
Initialize a test endpoint that demonstrates the correlation ID flow through the middleware chain
